how: Members repeatedly recruit help for equations, digits, fractals, and a last-minute construction proposal.

statement: explaining the canvas to an out-of-loop member
how: An out-of-loop member receives an explanation of the canvas and its placement interval.
An unnamed contest recognition cannot establish that the participant understands or identifies the canvas.
Members propose mathematical representations and alternatives without establishing a single adopted design for the whole room.
A participant reports placing a third supporting pixel and another reports border work on digits.
Recruitment includes anchor coordinates and a template reference, satisfying the element's minimal spatial form.
A member's proposal receives a direct commitment to help, supporting a local starter rather than a room-wide leader.
Direct responses include a bare join, a part-done report, and a commitment to work on relocation.
The invitation to make a cyan tau receives a bare acceptance after 24 minutes.
The contrast between bare acceptance and reason-giving refusal needs qualification because two construction calls receive bare refusals.
A construction call can close locally with an unexplained refusal instead of visible recruitment.
An ordinary recurring work-report thread supplies an additional venue for recruiting defenders of an existing canvas mark.
Visible individual work does not establish that participants never decided roles, leadership, or divisions elsewhere.
A request for scripted contribution ideas establishes interest but leaves actual automated placement unobserved.
Members repair digits, maintain the equation, and urge defenders to persist when it appears vulnerable.
Maintaining visible work also signals to others that the equation remains occupied and has not been abandoned.
Participants identify replacement by a blue logo or named sprites without demonstrating who controlled individual placers.
Visitors offer a non-aggression pact and describe an agreement to avoid covering the equation.
A visitor assures the room that an adjoining sprite will brush the equations without invading them.
A visitor offers help conditional on moving a number, while a member announces an intention to help another room.
A conditional help offer and a member's announced departure support offered assistance without establishing a completed reciprocal exchange.
A visitor carries a neighbour's pact proposal into the host discussion without proving authority to bind every placer.
A relocation proposal and commitment are followed by withdrawal, so weighing and attempting a move cannot guarantee collective relocation.
After losing a version of the identity, a participant searches for an existing version elsewhere instead of initiating another rebuild.
Giving up after an overwrite and urging persistence do not identify a settled judgement about the room's available hands.
Neighbour agreements and conditional help do not show a coalition or mutual defence organisation.
Coexistence and requests to move a number do not establish a host's rule over guest construction.
An agreement claim beside an invasion report leaves disputes over who may bind a room unobserved.
Participants bring mathematical knowledge and familiar notation into canvas proposals and a post-event negative-number joke.
A member explicitly proposes making the canvas resemble the room's existing mathematical sidebar.
False mathematics claims and their explicit April Fools explanation establish local play alongside canvas work.
Members call canvas posts spam, demand math content, and question moderator removals.
Member reports of removals establish a boundary dispute but cannot by themselves establish an enacted moderator policy.
A canvas proposal receives an explicit objection that the subreddit should carry math content rather than more canvas posts.
Members announce mathematical marks, claim a small spot, celebrate achievement, and ask which member made a pictured mark.
Participants report a mathematical design's replacement and record damage to digits or neighbouring art.
Post-event recognition develops into shared notation joking without identifying the maker or deciding which version should be preserved.
Looking for another existing identity does not demonstrate a post-event decision to retain the effort or move to a successor canvas.
The sarcastic notation correction and its joke replies leave collective curation or disputes over the preserved record unobserved.
A report that a praised picture displaced another room's Cat does not establish an intentional attack by the celebrating room.
Celebrating coexistence and reporting displacement do not show a sustained rivalry carried through taunts or victory claims against a named opponent.
A named canvas neighbour and its agreement provide no evidence of a quarrel predating the canvas.
Mathematical jokes do not name a pre-existing rival as the reason for an attack.
A repair call receives an explicit report of a third supporting pixel after eighteen minutes.
The same turn can propose a mark and recruit helpers, leaving no separate starter-to-call sequence to infer.
Reports of placement and continuing defence establish both activities without isolating the claimed building-to-upkeep cause.
A pact offer follows maintenance discussion, but a visitor's initiative does not establish that defenders initiated negotiation because upkeep caused erosion.
An agreement claim followed by celebration supports reported coexistence without establishing universal compliance or the agreement as its cause.
Defence under strain and a scripted-ideas request do not establish a transition to actual automated upkeep.
Placement reports and achievement claims coexist without a cited turn establishing that the former caused the latter.
Damage reporting and celebration coexist, but the record does not show celebration causing preservation or retrospective recording.
Reporting the identity's fate and locating another version do not show a subsequent decision to carry the collective effort forward.
The withdrawn relocation proposal does not establish that a judgement of too few hands produced a collective move.
A template reference embedded in recruitment does not show prior design disagreement settled through that template.
Announcing help for another room and receiving a conditional help offer do not establish outside assistance caused by a shortage of defenders.
A proposal combines moving a number with offered help, but completed help following a settled border is unobserved.
Recruitment followed by reported displacement does not establish that the room issued an attack call against a rival.
A visitor's non-invasion assurance is visible without a local attack call that it demonstrably answers.
The agreement claim answers an invasion complaint from the target rather than a local call to attack another work.
An invasion report and later cooperation claim do not demonstrate an attack call producing a continuing rivalry in talk.
Maintenance and neighbour contact leave the proposed transition into a coalition unobserved.
The claim that a neighbour agreed to avoid the equation does not demonstrate a subsequent dispute over authority to bind placers.
